population_unit: registered motor vehicles for unrestricted road use, not insurance policy/cover exposures

publisher_summary.operational_interpretation: Reconstructed population must preserve the reported top-level fleet total by design, without treating this as vehicle-level truth.

state_class_controls.source: Table 1: eight states and territories by ten motor vehicle types
state_class_controls.decision: Retain all 80 source cell values, preserve publisher sources and additivity residuals; decide hard/soft treatment only after consistency review.

published_disclosure_rules: Publisher suppresses small-count cells fewer than three
Additional secondary cells, including totals, may be perturbed or suppressed
Summing cell values may differ from published totals

geography.garaging_postcode: reported garaging postcode, sometimes fallback to registered postcode
geography.safety: Never equate registration postcode to garaging postcode or assume their row-level linkage is observed.

model_validation.pairwise_margin_checks: diagnostics only; not predictive holdout accuracy
model_validation.holdout_plan: Reserve independently published margins for M1.3 synthetic-joint predictive evaluation.
required_before_synthesis: reconcile BITRE source universe and Table 1 published control hierarchy
review suppression/perturbation error model and acceptable constraints
identify sparse support before constructing joint feature distribution
review source licence/privacy and small-cell output decisions
demonstrate out-of-sample marginal accuracy and uncertainty ensembles
